d: In this video, Firstpost explains why Apple’s new touchscreen MacBook Pro is facing a wave of online criticism. Users are sharing images and complaints about fingerprint marks and smudges appearing across the display. Some are even joking that Apple may need to sell premium gloves alongside its laptops. Others are questioning whether a touchscreen is necessary on a MacBook at all. After years of keeping touch input largely on the iPhone and iPad, Apple is bringing it to its flagship laptop. Is this a genuine innovation or another expensive feature users never asked for? Gursshheenkaur…
